cases.purpose: Verify exact GNU diagnostic and status for an unmapped effective UID at top level and inside a shell function; the shell continues.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils 9.7 whoami(1) in an identically built user namespace
cases.comparison: Exact status, stdout and stderr parity with GNU, including the whoami diagnostic prefix and UID; setup verifies namespace identity and absence of a passwd/NSS entry inside the namespace.

files.inner.sh:
mark() { printf "[%s]\n" "$1"; printf "[%s]\n" "$1" >&2; }
run() { mark "$1"; shift; whoami "$@"; printf "status=%d\n" "$?"; }
mark direct
whoami
printf "status=%d\n" "$?"
run function --
mark after
printf "shell-continues\n"

cases.stderr:
[direct]
whoami: cannot find name for user ID 4242
[function]
whoami: cannot find name for user ID 4242
[after]
